feats.title: Arcing Throw
feats.description: When you use a spear as a thrown weapon, the target doesn't gain cover from its allies.

feats.title: Earth's Punishment
feats.description: When an adjacent enemy that is marked by you makes an attack that does not include you as a target, and hits and damages at least one of your allies, it takes damage equal to your Constitution.

feats.title: Earthstrength Defenses
feats.description: When you use your second wind, you gain a bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will equal to your Constitution until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Earthstrength Resolve
feats.description: When any enemy marked by you makes an attack that doesn't include you as a target, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution.

feats.title: Enhanced Font of Life
feats.description: You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws granted by your Font of Life.

feats.title: Font of Vengeance
feats.description: When you save against ongoing damage at the start of your turn, if you are adjacent to and can make an opportunity attack against the creature that inflicted the ongoing damage, you deal damage to that creature equal to your Strength.

feats.title: Forceful Smash
feats.description: Whenever you score a critical hit with a hammer or a mace, the target is knocked prone.

feats.title: Gusting Rebuke
feats.description: When an enemy adjacent to you that is marked by you hits and damages one of your allies with an attack that does not include you as a target, you can push the enemy a number of squares equal to your Constitution as an immediate reaction.

feats.title: Lifespirit Healing
feats.description: When you use your second wind, a second ally within 5 squares of you can spend a healing surge and make a saving throw.

feats.title: Maneuvering Attack
feats.description: When you pull, push, or slide a target with an attack using a polearm or a spear, that target grants combat advantage to you until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Quickening Font
feats.description: When you save against an effect at the start of your turn, your speed increases by 1 until the end of your turn.

feats.title: Stormheart Thunder
feats.description: When you use Stormheart to slow an enemy, that enemy gains vulnerable 5 thunder until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Vengeful Grasp
feats.description: When you use Warden's Grasp, you can choose to push the target 3 squares rather than slide it 1 square.

feats.title: Wellspring of Life
feats.description: When you succeed on a saving throw granted by your Font of Life, each ally adjacent to you gains a +1 bonus to saving throws until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Wildblood Retribution
feats.description: When you use your second wind, if any enemy marked by you makes an attack that doesn't include you as a target before the start of your next turn, you can make a melee basic attack against that enemy as a free action during your next turn.

feats.title: Wildblood Speed
feats.description: When any enemy marked by you makes an attack that doesn't include you as a target, you can shift a number of squares equal to your Wisdom as a free action.
